title: Generational language landscape
scope: Qualitative sociolinguistic configuration of the initial region: the two principal speech varieties, the hillfort's generational split between older-generation parallel bilingualism and younger-generation hybridising speech, the imperial-script literacy anchor, the outlet settlement's default speech, and interpreter-capable competence as personal reputation only; strictly sociolinguistic logic, fixing no word, name, sound, grammar feature, letterform, sample utterance, variety name, culture content, rite language, inscription, institution, office, procedure, demography, or change to natural System behaviour.
claims: Two distinct speech varieties are the region's principal ones: the tongue of the withdrawn imperial power and the original tongue (author-facing labels only); they are principal, not exhaustive, and whether the displaced-arrival and itinerant-craft or trade strands carry further varieties, dialects, or trade-speech habits of their own remains open.

The hillfort's landscape is generationally split; the older generation lives in parallel bilingualism, with both parent tongues standing side by side as full daily languages keyed to strand and situation — households leading with their strand leaning, mixed crews switching as the moment demands — and practiced code-switching as ordinary adult competence.
The younger generation, raised with both tongues from childhood, is actively hybridising: using the two together and mixing words from both tongues within a single sentence.

That hybridising speech is an in-progress generational development, not a settled or named third language; how far it will carry, whether it stabilises, and whether the parent tongues recede are explicitly open questions, argued within the fiction and unsettled here.
Neither parent tongue is dying as fact, and no strand owns either tongue.

Literacy, where it exists, is anchored to the imperial script tradition, which holds the record function — a living skill class descended from imperial practice, not from any intact archive or knowledge store — and the original tongue is customarily unwritten.
The outlet settlement is imperial-monolingual by default, so cross-lake dealings lean on hillfort speakers, a quiet standing asymmetry.

Recognised interpreter-capable individuals exist at the hillfort as personal competence and reputation only; they are never an office and never part of adjudication, and they create no procedure, standing, entitlement, or right to be heard.

The proposal's option-independent shared frame is also established: the imperial tongue owns the surviving written-record tradition as a living practice; comprehension between the two settlements is ordinary, with the direction of accommodation left open; and literacy is uneven across strands, households, generations, and professions (WLD-CULTURE-001 restated, not re-litigated).
boundaries: This record is a forward culture extension filling declared-open sociolinguistic space; it alters no accepted geography, ecology, location, history, event, or culture record, and every open boundary of every record it touches stays open except for the narrowly declared closures stated here.

Tongue, variety, parent tongue, hybridising speech, code-switching, register, script tradition, and every other label are author-facing qualitative descriptions; no variety is named, and no word, name, sound, grammar feature, letterform, orthography, spelling, or sample utterance is established in any variety — all linguistic content remains a protected unknown — and the labels fix no institution, office, law, measurement, proportion, or performance guarantee.

Declared qualitative closure of the region's sociolinguistic structure — which varieties exist and how they are used — and that only; final names, vocabularies, phonologies, grammars, and any script's actual letterforms remain protected unknowns.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-LOCATION-005's open language item: the outlet settlement's default everyday speech, and that only; its internal speech composition, minority presence, and every other item that boundary lists — law, belief, practice, institution, dress, craft style, ancestry proportion, internal uniformity — stay open, and primarily still does not mean exclusively.

Declared bounded closure of WLD-HISTORY-001's open language item: a tongue of the withdrawn power survives in the region as a living speech variety, and its regional position, and that only; the power's name, that tongue's identity, its script identity, its extent, its historical spread, and every element of its content stay open.

No further closure is declared; in particular no original-tongue script tradition, revival current, or written memory-keeping practice is established, the original tongue is customarily unwritten, and the imperial script tradition is the only anchored literacy here.

The hybridising speech is in progress, unnamed, and unsettled; it is not a third language, it is not established as a common institution of speech, it fixes no variety inventory, and no stabilisation, generational outcome, language death, or future timeline of any kind is claimed.

Older generation and younger generation are author-facing cohort descriptions fixing no age, birth cohort, generation boundary, cohort size or proportion, rate, or timetable; where one cohort ends and the next begins remains open.

WLD-CULTURE-001's braid stands: no strand dissolves and no strand dominates, no strand is monolingual and no strand owns either tongue; the hybridising speech is no strand's inheritance and belongs to none of them, household traditions including household speech habits persist, the generational pattern is a tendency with no cohort unanimity — some young lean to one parent tongue or to purist household usage, consistent with the reaching-back texture of canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/settlement-founding-fusion-blend — and variety command and movement between tongues are fallible social readings only, never a System category, status scale, eligibility, or coming-of-age recognition.

Uneven literacy is WLD-CULTURE-001 restated, not re-litigated; no archive, school, curriculum, teaching institution, literacy-transmission custom, record content, or record accuracy is established, and WLD-LOCATION-004's ceiling stands, with no remnant granting intact knowledge stores or preserved archives.

WLD-CULTURE-002 keeps every compact term, office, ambiguity class, and open question; interpreter-capable competence touches adjudication not at all, creating no procedure, standing, entitlement, right to be heard, or right of assistance, and every assembly size, cadence, quorum, selection procedure, and representation rule stays open; any concrete pairing of charter, oath, testimony, or record language with a particular variety is option-local illustrative material only, binding nothing, composing with every reading of WLD-CULTURE-002, and establishing no oath text, written charter, or record accuracy.

The generational split is consistent with the early-stage cultural hybridisation established by canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/settlement-founding-fusion-blend, which remains the sole authority for the settlement's founding frame and blend; this record restates none of its claims, adds no founding-era fact, and establishes nothing about the founder's, the dynasty's, or any office-holder's origin, strand, or speech.

canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/original-kin-hall-season-court-culture and canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/imperial-charter-and-guild-culture remain the authorities for their own cultural content; this record fixes none of it and assigns no culture-frame content, self-designation, or institution to either variety.

No liturgical or rite language is assigned; canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/lifecycle-threshold-witness-rites owns lifecycle rites, which may be conducted in any variety, and this record establishes, modifies, and interprets no rite, no rite meaning, and no afterlife or Soul belief.

No inscription, contract language, or monetary vocabulary is established; canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/dual-sphere-exchange-media owns exchange media, and whether any medium bears writing at all remains its question.

Speech asymmetries and prestige postures colour WLD-EVENT-001's standing rivalry as tendencies only; no incident, envoy, treaty, embargo, negotiation, trade language, market, price, or monetary fact is established.

Cross-lake dealings sit within WLD-LOCATION-002's accepted fair-weather bands and WLD-LOCATION-003's accepted shore arrangement, which this record does not divide, extend, shorten, or recalculate; no shore institution, schedule, worker role, structure, or route is created.

WLD-ECOLOGY-005's provenance discipline and WLD-HISTORY-001's presence classes continue to govern; the speech of returning non-human peoples, other basin communities, resident outsiders, and all neighbours is reported-only knowledge that proves nothing, no non-human language fact is established, and the parked sapient pack species remains parked, gaining no language, culture, biology, or ability development.

The System is objective architecture that cultures only interpret; no variety, literacy, or speech practice confers better System access, truer readouts, or any eligibility, interface language is culturally influenced presentation and remains deliberately unsettled (CAL0 UI1.0D, UI1.2D, WLD1.1D), language and literacy are not awakening prerequisites and no natural-law awakening is modified (CAL0 WLD1.0D), and no institution gains System-executed power (CAL0 SOC1.2D).

No CAL0 change, new System mechanic, readout guarantee, or project-default adoption is created; the series-adopted WLD-PRENATAL-001A guardrail stands untouched, and no speech, literacy, or teaching practice has any prenatal, developmental, or mechanical effect.

The landscape is author-side sociolinguistic truth as a pattern; a character knows another household's speech habits, another generation's usage, or the distribution of competence only through an available source, and no character surveys the whole landscape.

Quiet advantage for record-literate and both-tongued households, a register dimension to succession argument, and the cross-lake asymmetry are standing pressures at story start, not occurred events; no protagonist fact, character fact, speaker proportion, demographic figure, date, price, measurement, or occurred incident is established.
story_implications: Later scenes may use adult code-switching, young mixed-sentence speech, argument about where the mixing leads, record-literate advantage, and reliance on hillfort speakers in cross-lake dealings, but every particular speaker, exchange, argument, dispute, and outcome requires its own evidence.
Whether the hybridising speech stabilises is a live in-fiction argument, not a settled fact; no scene may treat its outcome, a third language, or either parent tongue's death as established.

Quiet advantage for record-literate and both-tongued households, a register dimension to succession argument, and the cross-lake speech asymmetry are standing pressures at story start, not occurred events.

Interpreter-capable reputation gives a character social usefulness only; it confers no office, no adjudication role, and no entitlement, and any such role would require its own evidence under WLD-CULTURE-002.
The landscape does not become automatic character knowledge; a character knows another household's or generation's speech only through an available source.
system_implications: The selected landscape is an ordinary setting extension; every language claim is cultural practice and interpretation over unchanged natural System behaviour.

No variety, literacy, or speech practice confers better System access, truer readouts, or any eligibility; interface language is culturally influenced presentation and remains deliberately unsettled (CAL0 UI1.0D, UI1.2D, WLD1.1D).
Language and literacy are not awakening prerequisites and no natural-law awakening is modified (CAL0 WLD1.0D); no institution gains System-executed power (CAL0 SOC1.2D).
No CAL0 change, new System mechanic, readout guarantee, or project-default adoption is created, and the series-adopted WLD-PRENATAL-001A guardrail stands untouched.
research_questions: All final names, vocabularies, phonologies, grammars, and any script's actual letterforms remain protected unknowns for a separate naming workflow.
Which tongue or tongues the System interface presents in, and for whom, remains deliberately unsettled under CAL0 UI1.0D presentation.
Whether the younger generation's hybridising speech stabilises, how far it carries, and whether either parent tongue recedes remain open and argued within the fiction.
Literacy transmission — who teaches reading, and whether any school, archive, or curriculum exists — remains open with no institution proposed.
Inter-settlement accommodation — who switches for whom in trade, and whether interpreter customs ever harden into anything institutional — remains open.

Dialect-level variation inside each tongue, whether the displaced-arrival and itinerant-craft or trade strands carry further varieties or trade-speech habits, and how far the outlet's imperial tongue has drifted from its historical parent remain open.
The speech of other basin communities, resident outsiders, and returning non-human peoples remains provenance-bounded and undeveloped.
How speech figures in the rites, the exchange media, and the three culture frames remains owned by the sibling records and open here.

author_approval.evidence: On 2026-08-17 the Author accepted this record through explicit multiple-choice selections, choosing an amended custom combination rather than any single displayed card — the drafted Option C parallel bilingualism for the older generation, amended to drop its remembered original-tongue script tradition, combined with an emerging Option-B-like hybridising development among the young that is explicitly in progress and is not a settled or named third language — together with the proposal's option-independent shared claim set.
